title: Body-oriented relaxation techniques for patients with life-limiting illnesses
summary: Pilot study to assess the short-term effects of body-oriented relaxation techniques on aspects of quality of life in patients with indications for specialized palliative care
conditions: Adults with indications for specialized palliative care
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• All individual indications for specialized palliative care or 
  inpatients with confirmed cystic fibrosis
• Patients are able to understand the information provided
• Patients are able to give written consent
• Consent prior to inclusion in the study
Exclusion criteria:
• Age < 18 years
• Unstable fracture
• Lack of informed consent
• Inability to understand the information provided due to the nature of the illness, limited ability to communicate in German, hearing impairment
